rationale: Calling off 3,498 collars from Kingsbury holds the Orchid Regional Airways slot for USD 17.2K and removes WO-2606 from a restart date that Taoyuan has not committed to, where every extra day costs USD 4K on a key customer. Re-sequencing on a partial kit costs nothing but only works if Taoyuan really ships on 22 Oct and planning can keep crews busy on 214 collars, so keep it as the fallback if Kingsbury cannot confirm stock. The 2024 typhoon (PRE-06) was solved the same way at a 35% premium on 6,000 fasteners.

qa.answer: Four options. Pull forward WO-2606 collars from Kingsbury stock by air (USD 17.2K, no slip, recommended), induct WO-2606 on the 214 collars on hand and re-sequence tasks (no cost, holds only if Taoyuan ships on 22 Oct), wait for the restart (USD 8K of LDs, Orchid Regional moves 2 days), or move two later Hsinchu lines to Kingsbury and Saone Rivets (saves USD 516 and de-risks lines that feed no work order yet).

Splitting the later taper-lok and nut lines is the cheapest at a USD 516 net saving, because Kingsbury's taper-lok bolt is USD 1 cheaper than Hsinchu's, but it does nothing for WO-2606. The partial-kit re-sequence costs nothing and protects WO-2606 if the 22 Oct date holds. The recommended Kingsbury call-off costs USD 14K of price premium plus about USD 3.2K of LAX to SIN freight.

In 2024 a typhoon closed two north Taiwan fastener plants for 8 days while airframe checks needed pins and collars inside a week (PRE-06). We pulled 6,000 fasteners forward from US distributor stock at a 35% premium, for USD 38.5K and 1 day of slip, and both heavy checks held their slots. The lesson was to keep a standing price agreement with the US fastener source for emergency volume.

WO-2606 inducts into Hangar 3 bay 2 on 18 Oct and needs 3,600 lockbolt collars from Taoyuan line 4500018417-00010. The typhoon shutdown moves the delivery to 22 Oct, a 4 day slip against 2 days of float, so the Orchid Regional Airways redelivery moves from 11 Nov to 13 Nov. WO-2605 slips 4 days on Hsinchu pins but has 6 days of float, so its 17 Nov redelivery holds.
